# Priyam Rupapara

> Systems Builder, Engineer, and Founder based in Rajkot and Delhi, India. Specializing in operational automation, diagnostic lab infrastructure, Indian D2C unit economics, and edge autonomous systems.

- Website: https://priyamrupapara.com

## Overview

Priyam Rupapara builds software for messy, physical, real-world operations where generic SaaS fails. Focuses on vibe coding, agentic workflows, and rapid 0-to-1 shipping across healthcare, commerce, and autonomous edge hardware.

## Core Projects

### 1. Kliniqo (Diagnostic Healthcare Operations & LIS)
- Live Website: https://kliniqo.co.in
- Working MVP deployed in active diagnostic pathology laboratories.
- Real-time ASTM E1394 serial machine protocol bridging to ingest automated blood and serum analyzers (CBC, Biochemistry, Electrolytes) without manual data entry.
- Automated QC validation, range checking, delta checks, and instant report distribution via WhatsApp and PDF.
- Offline-first local desktop/LAN architecture.

### 2. Vaibhav Laboratory (Live Diagnostic Storefront, built on Kliniqo)
- Live Website: https://vaibhavlabs.com
- Public booking and e-commerce site for an 18-year-old pathology lab in Rajkot, Gujarat, running on Kliniqo.
- Searchable test catalogue, cart and checkout, home-collection booking, same-day reporting, WhatsApp report delivery.
- Fully trilingual interface: English, Hindi, Gujarati.

### 3. FaceCard (NFC Social Card, pre-launch)
- Website: https://facecard.co.in
- Physical NFC card tapped on a phone to exchange contact, profile and intent in one gesture.
- Three variants: Devil, Angel, Witness. Brand, product and site designed end to end.
- Status: waitlist open in Delhi and Gurugram; hardware not yet shipped.

### 4. Ecommerce Hub (Indian D2C Truth Layer)
- Financial analytics and real-time reconciliation engine tailored for Indian e-commerce.
- Solves attribution gaps across Razorpay, Cash on Delivery (COD), Return to Origin (RTO) freight penalties, and multi-channel marketing CAC.
- Real-time unit margin calculation factoring NDR (Non-Delivery Report) workflows and reverse logistics costs.

### 5. SURGE Men (D2C Brand Case Study & Post-Mortem)
- Live Website: https://surgemen.in
- Formulated 7 men's hair styling products alongside cosmetic chemists in Gujarat.
- Deep operational analysis and post-mortem of an Indian D2C men's grooming brand.
- Financial teardown of blended CAC, gross margin compression, COD delivery friction, and inventory churn dynamics in the Indian consumer market.

### 6. Autonomous Defence AI (ambition, not shipped) & Drone Telemetry
- MAVLink and PX4 SITL avionics telemetry simulator.
- Real-time edge compute, 3D radar/horizon tracking, and automated target interception simulation.

## Technical Skills & Philosophy
- **Philosophy:** Vibe coding, agentic orchestration, pragmatic operational systems, zero fluff.
- **Languages:** Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, C++, SQL, HTML5/CSS3.
- **Frameworks & Tools:** Next.js, React, Node.js, Prisma, TailwindCSS, WebSockets, Canvas 2D/3D, MAVLink, ASTM Protocols.
